questions.prompt: Why can tone be misread in text?
questions.answer: The recipient lacks some context or tone available to the sender.
questions.feedback: Avoid treating all written communication as deficient.

questions.prompt: Is eye contact reliable proof of honesty?
questions.answer: No; gaze alone cannot establish motive or truthfulness.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Separates cues from inference, generates alternatives and selects proportionate clarification or action.
scoring.transfer: Develop a fictional cue-analysis table for four observations across text and spoken communication. Include at least two plausible explanations, a decision consequence, one clarification and one case where no question is needed. Explain how evidence would change your inference.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
